name: thinloop
description: Simplify complex development with Issue-backed discovery, risk-adaptive Web experience and architecture design, autonomous PR delivery, evidence-backed maintenance, concise experiential knowledge, and human-approved skill evolution.

interface.shortDescription: Discovery, design, delivery, maintenance, knowledge, and evolution
interface.longDescription: Clarify consequential product decisions into one GitHub Issue, design Web experiences and technical boundaries at the lightest useful fidelity, keep implementation scoped and evidence-backed, merge eligible pull requests into main, leave real-use acceptance to the user, audit or repair repository drift on request, preserve proven development experience, and evolve used Thinloop skills through human-approved reversible trials.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use SCD Discovery when product decisions are open, SCD UIUX when a Web experience needs design, SCD Architecture when domain, system, or shared interface boundaries need design, SCD QuickDev for Issue-backed implementation through eligible PR merge, SCD Maintenance only when I explicitly ask to audit or repair repository debt, SCD Knowledge only when I explicitly ask to capture or retrieve proven experience, and SCD Evolve only when I explicitly ask to diagnose this interaction and improve a Thinloop skill.
